title: TIBECG: Temporal Information Bottleneck for Lead-Specific Demographic Privacy in ECG Waveform Release
abstract: arXiv:2611.21694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transmitting an electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform can expose demographic information beyond an intended diagnostic task. We evaluate TIBECG, an architectural temporal information bottleneck, on individual leads extracted from hospital twelve-lead recordings. A 2,302,337-parameter processor varies its latent length while retaining the same nine-score consistency objective, without age or sex labels in protector fitting. Across 6,386 recordings, ten folds, 12 leads and 21 lengths, retrospective selections retained at least 95% of each lead's clean macro-F1. Their weaker age/sex interval gain exceeded the best eligible conventional transformation on all leads, by a median 22.08 percentage points. The implemented sampling-rate comparison shows that direct downsampling usually suppresses demographic inference more strongly but at a larger loss of diagnostic utility, whereas TIBECG favors utility preservation. Selection stability also varies

translated_title: TIBECG：用于心电图波形发布中导联级人口统计隐私保护的时序信息瓶颈
translated_abstract: 传输心电图（ECG）波形可能会在预期诊断任务之外暴露人口统计信息。我们在从医院十二导联记录中提取的单个导联上评估了TIBECG——一种架构层面的时序信息瓶颈方法。该处理器包含2,302,337个参数，可在保持相同九项分数一致性目标的同时改变其潜在表示长度，且在保护器的拟合过程中不使用年龄或性别标签。在6,386条记录、十折交叉验证、12个导联和21种长度的实验中，回溯性选择保留了每个导联至少95%的干净宏F1分数。其在较弱的年龄/性别区间增益方面，在所有导联上均超过了最佳符合条件的传统变换方法，中位数优势达22.08个百分点。实施的采样率比较表明，直接降采样通常能更强地抑制人口统计推断，但诊断效用损失更大，而TIBECG则更倾向于保留诊断效用。选择稳定性同样存在差异……
tldr: TIBECG通过时序信息瓶颈机制，在保留心电图诊断效用（宏F1不低于95%）的同时，显著抑制了波形发布中年龄、性别等人口统计信息的泄露，隐私增益较最佳传统变换方法中位数提升22.08个百分点。
en_tdlr: TIBECG applies a temporal information bottleneck to ECG waveform release, preserving at least 95% of diagnostic macro-F1 while suppressing age/sex demographic leakage, outperforming the best conventional transformations by a median 22.08 percentage points in privacy gain.
